name: audio-coldboot
symbols_from_why: Runs against the PINNED BASE ROM: every symbol it reads is vanilla.
description: Doc 67 item J, instrument shakedown. Identical to audio-smoke except it COLD BOOTS instead of resuming a savestate. audio-smoke captured 25 s of perfect silence off emerald_overworld.ss1, and a savestate restoring RAM without the APU's own state is one of exactly two explanations; the other is that the tap reads the wrong buffer. Emerald's intro plays music within a few hundred frames, so this run discriminates them. Asserts almost nothing on purpose -- it is an observation.

probes.why: Which screen the run reached, so a silent result can be attributed.
